sentences.text: Samuel Timothy `` Tim '' McGraw -LRB- born May 1 , 1967 -RRB- is an American country singer , songwriter and actor .	country	Country music
He has been married to singer Faith Hill since 1996 , and is the son of the late baseball player Tug McGraw .	Faith Hill	Faith Hill	Tug McGraw	Tug McGraw

McGraw began singing in a neotraditional country style , but starting with 1997 's Everywhere , he developed a more crossover-friendly , country pop sound , making him one of the first male Country singers of his generation to crossover to Pop .	Country	Country music	country	Country music	neotraditional country	neotraditional country	Everywhere	Everywhere (Tim McGraw album)	country pop	country pop

McGraw has released fourteen studio albums -LRB- eleven for Curb Records and three for Big Machine Records -RRB- .	Curb	Curb Records	Big Machine	Big Machine Records	Curb Records	Curb Records	Big Machine Records	Big Machine Records

10 of those albums have reached number 1 on the Top Country Albums charts , with his 1994 breakthrough album Not a Moment Too Soon being the top country album of 1994 .	Country	Country music	country	Country music	Top Country Albums	Top Country Albums	Not a Moment Too Soon	Not a Moment Too Soon

All of these albums have produced 65 singles , 25 of which have reached number 1 on the Hot Country Songs or Country Airplay charts .	Country	Country music	Hot Country Songs	Hot Country Songs	Country Airplay	Country Airplay

Three of these singles -- `` It 's Your Love , '' `` Just to See You Smile , '' and `` Live Like You Were Dying '' -- were the top country songs of 1997 , 1998 , and 2004 according to Billboard Year-End .	country	Country music	Just to See You Smile	Just to See You Smile	Live Like You Were Dying	Live Like You Were Dying (song)
